setting: A student talks with the recreation office about joining the intramural soccer league before the deadline.
narrator_intro: Listen to a conversation between a student and a staff member at the recreation office.

dialogue.speaker: speaker1
dialogue.text: Hi. I want to join the intramural soccer league this semester. Am I too late?

dialogue.speaker: speaker2
dialogue.text: Almost. Team rosters close Friday at five, and every player needs a cleared online waiver before then.

dialogue.speaker: speaker1
dialogue.text: I already have a team—we're short one midfielder. Do I register myself or does the captain do it?

dialogue.speaker: speaker2
dialogue.text: Your captain adds you in the portal, then you complete the waiver and pay the twelve-dollar fee. Until both are done, you won't appear on the roster.

dialogue.speaker: speaker1
dialogue.text: Can I play if my physical exam from last year is still on file?

dialogue.speaker: speaker2
dialogue.text: For club sports we need a physical from this academic year. The health center can do walk-ins tomorrow morning—bring your ID.

dialogue.speaker: speaker1
dialogue.text: Games are Sundays, right? I work until noon.

dialogue.speaker: speaker2
dialogue.text: Most divisions start at two, but check your pool schedule after Friday. Late adds sometimes get placed in the evening division.

dialogue.speaker: speaker1
dialogue.text: Okay. If I miss Friday, is there a waitlist?

dialogue.speaker: speaker2
dialogue.text: There's a waitlist for free-agent players, not for full teams. If your team is incomplete by Friday, the whole team is dropped.

dialogue.speaker: speaker1
dialogue.text: Got it. I'll finish the waiver tonight and book the physical for tomorrow.

narrator_outro: Now get ready to answer the questions.

questions.narrator_text: What is the conversation mainly about?

options.A: Renting soccer equipment for a class project
options.B: Registering for intramural soccer before the deadline
options.C: Changing the student's work schedule on Sundays
options.D: Trying out for the varsity soccer team

questions.explanation: He needs to join intramural soccer; she explains roster deadline, waiver, fee, and physical.
questions.commonMistake: Choosing D—this is intramural/club sports, not varsity tryouts.

options.A: Tomorrow morning at the health center

questions.explanation: Rosters close Friday at five, with waiver required before then.
questions.commonMistake: Choosing A—tomorrow is for the physical, not the roster deadline.

questions.narrator_text: What must be true about his physical exam?

options.B: It must be from this academic year
options.C: Only the team captain needs a physical
options.D: No physical is required for midfielders

questions.explanation: Club sports need a physical from this academic year; health center walk-ins are available tomorrow.
questions.commonMistake: Choosing A—he hoped last year counted; she says no.

options.C: They pay a double fee and play anyway
